# Guarantees

Figma: [08t. Guarantees](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=3658-127477) · Family: 08 Safqah-Specific · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

The bar’s width encodes the guarantee value on a fixed millions axis; the fill is the brand-green gradient, with the value labelled inside once the bar is wide enough. Rebuilt atoms→molecule→organism from the legacy component (which was font-blocked on IBM Plex Sans Arabic → now Noto Sans Arabic).

### Atomic architecture

### Atom

- AxisTick - one scale marker (tick + value label), e.g. “30 مليون”.

### Molecule

- GuaranteeBar - the track + gradient fill + in-bar value; Coverage sets the fill width.

### Organism

- Guarantees - title (program funding size) + GuaranteeBar + the millions axis.

### Coverage

Five discrete coverage levels - the fill width steps from Empty to Full. The in-bar value appears at High/Full where it fits.

### Direction - RTL and LTR

RTL (primary) fills from the right with the axis reading 30→0; LTR mirrors it.

### Usage - Do and Don't

Do

Keep the funding-size title, the bar, and the axis together so the coverage reads in context.

Do

Use the coverage levels to reflect the real guarantee ratio - a low ratio should read as a short bar.

Don’t

Don’t show the bar without its axis + title - the width means nothing without the scale.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Info:** Rebuilt atoms→molecule→organism. The brand-green gradient is our colour (kept as the fill); everything else is DS-tokenised.

> **Tip:** Coverage is discrete (Empty/Low/Mid/High/Full). For an exact ratio, set the fill width from data and swap the value text.

> **Warning:** The original component used IBM Plex Sans Arabic (won’t load here) → this rebuild uses Noto Sans Arabic; align to the DS Arabic font before publishing.
